statements.text: We also pioneered an artificial intelligence platform capable of predicting real-world mine safety risks based on decades of inspection and investigation data. As I sit here today, we are further refining this AI platform and will integrate its predictive data into inspector worn smart helmets that we soon will pilot across six mines.
